info.prompt: Hyper-stylized cross-section of a Heist Casino vault breach—transparent vault hologram at 5,200 points with 70% stolen crimson streams arcing toward the thief’s amber-gold avatar as other players activate role abilities: Headhunter’s skeletal claw interface intercepting with granite-crunch VFX, Archivist’s shield absorbing 20% as frosted cyan barriers, and Rainmaker’s extended heist window counting down in prismatic milliseconds above the chaos, all rendered in the game’s signature translucent ice-stone materiality with stress fractures mirroring the multiplier ladder’s step pattern.
